Melee (Requiem) â€” Introduction

This page is for information about the Melee mechanics in Resident Evil Requiem .

Resident Evil Requiem features a melee system used by both playable characters, Leon S. Kennedy and Grace Ashcroft . The two characters have substantially different melee systems.

Leon uses a hatchet as his primary melee weapon and can perform contextual melee attacks against staggered enemies, as well as character-specific finishing attacks. His melee system is heavily influenced by the combat mechanics of Resident Evil 4 .

Grace uses knives as her primary melee weapons. Her knife attacks can be performed directly and can also be used against staggered enemies.

Melee (Requiem) â€” Leon S. Kennedy

Leon has the more advanced melee system of the two protagonists.

His combat hatchet can be swung freely and can be used to perform stronger attacks. Shooting an enemy in the head or legs can create a stagger state, allowing Leon to follow up with a melee attack.

Leon can also perform contextual melee attacks based on the environment, including attacks near walls, obstacles, uneven ground, and ledges.

His melee system includes his characteristic roundhouse kick in addition to his hatchet-based attacks.

Melee (Requiem) â€” Character attacks

Leon retains his characteristic roundhouse kick as part of his contextual melee moveset. His combat is designed around shooting enemies to create melee opportunities, followed by powerful close-range attacks.

Grace's melee system is primarily knife-based and does not have Leon's extensive unarmed contextual moveset.

question: In Resident Evil Requiem, how many upgrades does it take to raise Grace Ashcroft's maximum health from 800 to 1200?
reference_answer: It takes four upgrades.

baseline.answer: I'm not familiar with Resident Evil Requiem, but I can try to help. After some thought, I'm going to take a guess: 4 upgrades.

rag.answer: According to [1], it takes four upgrades to raise Grace Ashcroft's maximum health from 800 to 1200 through the use of Steroids.

retrieved_chunks.text:
Health (Requiem) â€” Grace Ashcroft

Grace begins the game with a lower maximum health pool than Leon, emphasizing survival horror over direct combat. Her maximum health can be permanently increased by using Steroids , eventually increasing her maximum health from 800 to 1200 through four upgrades.

Steroids are obtained through exploration and crafting. Later in the game they may be crafted using an Empty Injector together with sufficient quantities of infected blood after obtaining the required crafting recipe. Because Empty Injectors are limited, players must choose between crafting Steroids or other injectable upgrades such as Stabilizers.

Grace also possesses a hidden "mercy" mechanic. Under most circumstances, attacks that would otherwise be fatal instead leave her with 1 HP provided the incoming damage does not exceed an internal threshold. Certain instant-kill attacks bypass this mechanic entirely. Community testing has confirmed this behavior, although it is not documented by Capcom.

Health (Requiem) â€” Maximum health

Grace permanently increases her maximum health by using Steroids .

Leon cannot increase his maximum health directly, instead relying on armor upgrades to improve survivability. This marks the first mainline title in which two playable protagonists use completely different long-term health progression systems.

Health (Requiem) â€” Summary

Resident Evil Requiem features two distinct health systems corresponding to its two playable protagonists, Grace Ashcroft and Leon S. Kennedy . Both systems share the traditional Resident Evil condition states of Fine , Caution and Danger , but differ in their presentation and progression. Grace's condition is displayed using an ECG monitor reminiscent of earlier entries in the series, while Leon's is represented by a segmented circular health indicator on the heads-up display.

Health is depleted when damage is received and restored through healing items. Unlike Resident Evil Village , both protagonists use separate progression systems: Grace can permanently increase her maximum health through Steroids , while Leon begins the game with a fixed maximum health and instead improves his survivability through armor upgrades.

retrieved_chunks.text:
R.I.P. Knife â€” Appears in

The R.I.P. Knife ( R.I.P.ãƒŠã‚¤ãƒ• , R. I. P. Naifu ) is a knife exclusive to Grace Ashcroft 's arsenal in Resident Evil Requiem . However, differ from Makeshift Knife and Hunting Knife , R.I.P Knife produced more infected blood, upon killing an enemy with this knife, double or triple the amount the player would usually get.

R.I.P. Knife â€” Gameplay

R.I.P. Knife is a weapon exclusive to Insanity difficulty. Throughout the game, this weapon can only be found at Rhodes Hill Chronic Care Center in two different locations, one of which required Antique Coin to unlock them. R.I.P. Knife can also be crafted if the player had acquired Blood Specimen (Polymerized) item, allowing for its crafting recipe to be unlocked.

To craft a R.I.P. knife, the player would need 1x Scrap and 110x Infected Blood . The knife is the second most durable out of all available knives to Grace's arsenal, lasting up to 46 attacks. When paired with Stakeout Takeout Charm, A Chunk can be taken out with 2 R.I.P. Knives, and on average, dealt 3 to 4 attacks on a common Zombie compared to 8 attempts needed for S&S M232 . When killing enemies with this knife, the amount of Infected Blood dropped will double or triple the set amount for each enemies.

Makeshift Knife â€” Gameplay

The Makeshift Knife is a weapon made from half of a scissor that can be used as melee or defensive. When grabbed, the Makeshift Knife can free the player from an enemy's attack, though its durability will be reduced by half. The weapon can be reobtained after killing the one that was used against. However, if the player gets attacked again, with the knife being used prior to being grabbed or the knife having a low durability, the weapon will break, requiring the player to find another one, or craft one .

Out of all defensive weapons for Grace, the Makeshift Knife has the lowest durability in game, but its status can be boosted with the Stakeout Takeout Charm which increases damage and durability of any knives.

The Makeshift Knife can be crafted with two Scraps, and it can also be reduced into one Scrap.

Antique Coin (Requiem) â€” Purpose

Antique Coins are used to open locked cabinets in Parlor - Care Center 1F, and are present through Wrenwood Hotel, Wrenwood Street and Rhodes Hill Chronic Care Center. However, they can only be collected by Grace Ashcroft . In Standard modes, Antique Coins are only present throughout the Care Center. On Insanity, the Handgun Ammo and R.I.P. Knife become available for purchase for 5 coins each. The total value of all items in Madhouse is 27 coins, and 36 are available in Insanity, Grace can also reduce the remaining Antique Coins to Scrap .

Gold â€” Resident Evil: The Darkside Chronicles

In The Darkside Chronicles , gold is only used to upgrade weapons. It appears in both the story mode and The Tofu Survivor .

Gold is gotten not just by picking it up from the environment, but also by destroying objects such as windows, lights, books, boxes, etc. Some objects will not give gold every time however. Just like in Resident Evil 5 , there are different types of gold: a "coin" and "bar" types, coins will generally give less gold than bars, but in later chapters, coins can give up to 3000 gold in each drop.

There are four titles related to gold in the game, they are:

Well-Off - Collect a total of 50,000 gold

Wealthy - Collect a total of 100,000 gold

Ultra-Rich - Collect a total of 150,000 gold

Weapon Master - Fully upgrade all weapons (requires 1,833,000 gold)

Additionally, there is a hidden "coin shoot" mechanic where if an object is destroyed and drops a coin of gold, it can be shot multiple times, each time it's shot the amount of gold given by the coin increases, there is however a limit on how much gold the coin will give this way, probably to avoid players from being able to gain huge chunks of gold early into the game.

question: In Resident Evil Requiem, on what date did the Nurse at Rhodes Hill Chronic Care Center receive Leon Kennedy?
reference_answer: She received him on the night of October 8, 2026.

baseline.answer: October 13th.

rag.answer: According to passage [1], the Nurse at Rhodes Hill Chronic Care Center received Leon Kennedy on the night of October 8, 2026.

retrieved_chunks.text:
Nurse (Requiem) â€” Biography

One of the subordinates of Victor Gideon , she served as an assistant and worker in the reception area in Rhodes Hill Chronic Care Center , attending to visitors and patients upon their admission.

On the night of October 8, 2026, she received Leon Kennedy , who had been told that Dr. Gideon was expecting him. While accompanying Leon to one of the rooms for their meeting, she mentioned that she had only recently started working at the center and that they cared for several inpatients, some undergoing experimental treatments prescribed by Dr. Gideon.

Later, after the beginning of the outbreak and the massacre at the center, she was brutally murdered in front of Leon by an infected doctor wielding a chainsaw.

Apparently, she was just another victim like the rest of Victor's subordinate workers and patients, sacrificed and unaware of what was really happening or what was to come at the center that night.

Leon Scott Kennedy â€” Raccoon City Syndrome (2026)

Kennedy had lost sight of Gideon but using Hughes's intel, Birkin directed him to Rhodes Hill Chronic Care Center , formerly sponsored by the Spencer Foundation before being bought by Gideon following Umbrella's collapse in 2004.

Arriving at the outskirts of Wrenwood, Kennedy arrived at the facility where he was welcomed by a newly recruited nurse , who told him Gideon had been expecting him. He let himself be guided to an examination room in the East Wing where he was told to wait. Unbeknownst to Kennedy, Gideon had been watching him through hidden surveillance, and ordered a Code 6 when the agent arrived. While waiting, Kennedy inspected an old photo of Gideon before alarms blared Code 6. The nurse shortly returned, asking him to be evacuated after claiming mass hysteria had affected all patients and staffs. However, shortly after, the nurse was killed by a chainsaw-wielding doctor, forcing Kennedy to battle the newly infected.

Rhodes Hill Chronic Care Center Outbreak â€” Event

Following Ashcroft's kidnapping from the Wrenwood Hotel, she was taken to East Wing Hospital Wards on Floor 2, and had her blood drawn with Gideon observing the process. Once a sufficient sample was drawn, Gideon had her blood tested and awaited the results throughout the night. Knowing the DSO would soon come for him, Gideon ordered Chairman Bennett to trigger Code 6 by 11:30PM, as he had accomplished his goal and no longer needed the institution. Soon after, Kennedy visited the center and was greeted by a nursing staff, with Gideon monitoring the agent through hidden cameras. Once Kennedy was escorted, Bennett triggered Code 6. However, unbeknownst to Bennett, much of the staff and patients throughout the building were all infected, though the means of transmission remained unknown. Kennedy was forced to defend himself against infected patients and staff.

question: In Resident Evil Requiem, what happens to the Hatchet's durability if it is used to parry a Chainsaw attack?
reference_answer: The Hatchet's durability becomes fully depleted.

baseline.answer: The Hatchet's durability is broken if it is used to parry a Chainsaw attack.

retrieved_chunks.text:
Hatchet (Requiem) â€” Gameplay

Similarly to Combat Knife in Resident Evil 4 (2023 game) . The Hatchet allows the players to perform brutal kills, albeit versatile against any enemies and weapons fired upon. Parries can be performed in two ways, the Regular Parry which Leon can damaged and pushed back enemies, and Perfect Parry which he dazed an enemy, before giving the player option to perform a finisher.

The Hatchet can perform light and heavy attacks, and counter all counterattacks by enemies. However, the Hatchet's durability will drop if used extensively, and require the players time to re-sharp with a metallic grindstone. Any melee-wielding enemies can be stunned for a few seconds if players parry, and projectile weapons shot by enemies could be deflected or destroyed if timed properly. When coming into contact with a chainsaw-wielding enemy, the Hatchet's durability will be immediately depleted if the player parries. If the player perfect parried Zombies , they would not mutated into Blister Heads . Perfect Parry is tricky to execute due to a limited window timeframe, whilst Regular Parry is more forgiving.

Chainsaw (Requiem) â€” Gameplay

The weapon first make its appearance in Rhodes Hill Chronic Care Center, after the unnamed Nurse was brutally killed by the chainsaw-wielding doctor. From then, the Chainsaw is wielded wildly by the infected, and could even be thrown against Leon. Upon killing the wielding infected, the Chainsaw is to be taken with caution, as the weapon can spin wildly, damaging the player if approached wrongly. Leon can used the weapon to his advantage, and is recommended to use in close-quarter combat. If the Chainsaw is left alone near an enemy, they would attempt to pick up. The Hatchet 's durability will be all depleted if parried against a Chainsaw attack.

If Leon is grappled, he would respond by ramming the chainsaw into the infected and kicks them, requiring the player to retake the weapon as the infected would try to dislodge Chainsaw, and use it against the player. The player should take precaution if the player embedded the chainsaw from behind an enemy, they would be damaged if the enemy turned around and attempted their attack. When the player leaves the Rehabilitation Ward, the Chainsaw would be lost as Leon sawed the door's iron latch.

if the player parries. If the player perfect parried Zombies , they would not mutated into Blister Heads . Perfect Parry is tricky to execute due to a limited window timeframe, whilst Regular Parry is more forgiving.
